propositions: The /health endpoint returns 200 without proving the container can serve MCP requests because it bypasses auth middleware, DNS-rebinding guards, and the session manager
A container with misconfigured REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS answers /health 200 while returning 421 to real MCP requests, yet autodeploy.sh promotes it without issuing any /mcp request
The blue-green cutover must drive a real MCP initialize handshake through the session manager during ASGI lifespan startup and publish the result on /health before uvicorn accepts connections

The handshake probe must select its Host from the declared public resource URL (REBAR_MCP_AUTH_RESOURCE_SERVER_URL) with fallbacks to allowlist entries and bind address to catch wrong-but-nonempty allowlists
The handshake drive must be bounded by a timeout (DEFAULT_HANDSHAKE_BUDGET_SECONDS=10), never raise, and report failures without blocking boot
The deploy gate must refuse promotion when handshake.ok is present and false, calling record_mcp_backoff_failure to gate the review-bot deploy
